newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Resource to take lead in case.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Resource to take lead in case.

text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc said Wednesday it has agreed with one of its affiliated physician practices to take the lead in managing the defense of patent litigation involving refractive eye surgery.

This litigation, which was instituted by Pillar Point Partners, Summit Partner Inc and Visx Partner Inc, revolves around three patents that are allegedly infringed by the refractive eye surgical procedure used by the company's affiliated practice, it explained.
The company said it has taken the lead in this action due to the potential positive impact of a favorable outcome on its other affiliated practices.
This litigation resulted in about $353,000 of defense costs being incurred by Physicians Resource Group during the fourth quarter of 1996, it noted.
